items.stem: The arm's-length principle requires that related-party transactions be priced as if:

options.text: They had occurred between independent parties under comparable conditions
options.rationale: Correct: the arm's-length principle benchmarks to independent-party pricing.

options.text: The group wished to minimise tax regardless of market terms
options.rationale: Pricing to minimise tax is precisely what the principle prevents.

options.text: No price were charged at all
options.rationale: Controlled transactions still need arm's-length pricing.

options.text: The parent dictated any convenient figure
options.rationale: Arbitrary intercompany prices fail the principle.

items.explanation: Correct: the arm's-length principle benchmarks to independent-party pricing.
